note: An Ochorus Original biography whose English quotes the American Standard Version (1901) with references marked "(…, ASV)"; in this French edition every quotation is Louis Segond 1910, pasted byte-for-byte by script, the version label dropped and the reference given in French form with Segond numbering (e.g. Psaume 46:2, Psaume 31:16, 2 Corinthiens 13:13, Marc 3:14-15). A handful are rendered from the English where the sentence argues from an ASV word Segond lacks (Ésaïe 40:31 « s’attendent », Hébreux 10:19 « l’assurance », Éphésiens 4:16 « approvisionnement »). The book's own two statements that its Scripture is the ASV are rendered to say the French edition quotes Segond. Rows come from two passes: every printed reference (mined where the block carries a verbatim Segond span of 45+ characters), and every quoted French span of 30+ characters that occurs verbatim in exactly one Segond verse.
